title: Standard Deduction for Salaried Employees
source: Ministry of Finance, Government of India (Union Budget Updates)
content: Standard deduction is a flat deduction allowed from gross salary income to salaried taxpayers and pensioners without requiring proof of actual expense receipts. Under the Old Tax Regime, the Standard Deduction is ₹50,000 per financial year. Under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC), for Tax Year 2026-27, the Standard Deduction is ₹75,000 for salaried employees and pensioners. It is deducted directly from gross income before applying income tax slabs.
